title: Matrix3D as SlimMatrix<3,3>, with a compile switch back to ConstSizeMatrix<9>
author: Claude-JG
description: Matrix3D becomes SlimMatrix<3,3> (#3456); EXUDYN_MATRIX3D_CONSTSIZE switches back to ConstSizeMatrix<9> for measurements and as fallback; the default-constructed Matrix3D sized later and the tests of NumberOfRows() == 0 checked; the test suite bitwise in the regular module, the performance models on both modules; the decision whether the switch is made for good follows the evaluation.
releaseNotes: Matrix3D is SlimMatrix<3,3> (EXUDYN_MATRIX3D_CONSTSIZE switches back to ConstSizeMatrix<9>); the results are bitwise unchanged; rigid-body models 8-17 % faster, all performance models 1.4 % (regular) and 3.1 % (fast) faster in total.
